messages:
nina-secops: Auditor follow-up: they want proof that RBAC change (removing `kms:Decrypt` from automation role) included a risk assessment and an incident playbook entry. Also need evidence that KMS keys were rotated within our SLA (72 hours) after the change. Who can assemble?
omar-infra: I'll collect the risk assessment doc and KMS CloudTrail events. We keep a risk entry in Confluence under /security/risk/2025-kms-rbac. It contains approver names and mitigation steps.
auditor-rep: We want the Confluence export (PDF) and a mapping showing which page sections cover risk acceptance, mitigation, and monitoring. Timestamps and role titles OK to keep; personal emails should be redacted.
rachel-gov: Also include the incident playbook entry that references SecretsManager rotation. Playbook ID: IP-9. Include the playbook revision history. Auditors will want to see that the playbook was updated before the rotation.
evidence-bot: evidence-bundle created: bundle-2793239000 -> s3://redwood-evidence/exports/2793239000/bundle-2793239000.zip
omar-infra: CloudTrail extraction in progress. Query for KMS events: `eventName in ["RotateKey","EnableKeyRotation","Encrypt","Decrypt","GenerateDataKey"]` between 2025-12-05 and 2025-12-06. Will include eventID, userIdentity.principalId, requestParameters.keyId.
auditor-rep: For SLA proof: a simple CSV with rotationTimestamp and keyId showing rotation within 72 hours is sufficient.
nina-secops: Make sure to include the approval ticket: TICKET-SEC-2015 with signoff by Security Lead and Platform Manager. Also include screenshots or export of the playbook commit in our repo (playbooks/ip-9.md commit hash 7a11e2).
omar-infra: Uploads done: confluence_risk_2025_kms.pdf (redacted), playbook_ip-9_history.json, kms_rotation_2793239000.csv. evidence-bot: presigned links generated with TTL 7 days.
auditor-rep: Received. One more ask: can you show the validation that the secrets re-encrypted with new key actually failed with old key? A test log showing a Decrypt attempt with the old key returning AccessDenied is helpful.
omar-infra: We have an automated validation log: `kms_reencrypt_validation.log` showing a Decrypt attempt timestamped 2025-12-06T02:02:10Z against key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/oldkey -> AccessDenied, then successful Encrypt/Decrypt with new key id/ef12-aaaa. Adding to bundle.
auditor-rep: Perfect. That, plus the risk assessment and playbook revision history, should close the loop for the control evidence. Thanks.
nina-secops: Final note: document the chain of custody for the evidence bundle in README and keep a copy in our compliance bucket. I'll update the compliance tracker. Closing thread.
